# Version 4.151.0
> **Performance and Skia m151** · Released July 30, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.151.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 bundles Skia milestone m151 and ports several hot paths to managed code for speed. Colour conversion, premultiplication, and HarfBuzz text-shaping helpers move from native round-trips to allocation-free managed implementations, and WASM gains Emscripten 5.0.6 support for .NET 11.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m151** — Bumps the bundled Skia engine to Chrome milestone m151 and merges several rounds of upstream chrome/m151 bug fixes. ([#4294](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4294), [#4489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4489), [#4443](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4443), [#4382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4382), [#4312](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4312))

## API Surface

- **SKColor, SKColorF, and premultiply conversions ported to managed code** — SKColor<->SKColorF conversion and single-value premultiply/unpremultiply now run in managed integer/float math instead of calling into native Skia, and gain new ReadOnlySpan<char> hex-parsing overloads. ([#4370](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4370), [#4385](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4385), [#4345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4345))
- **HarfBuzzSharp text shaping goes allocation-free** — Buffer.AddUtf8(string), Tag.Parse, SKFourByteTag.Parse, and SKShaper glyph reads avoid per-call allocations and native round-trips. ([#4376](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4376), [#4408](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4408), [#4396](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4396), [#4388](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4388))
- **WASM adds Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries for .NET 11** — New native WASM assets let .NET 11 apps build against Emscripten 5.0.6, and a preview-.NET WASM test job catches exception-handling regressions. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4459](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4459), [#4488](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4488))

## Bug Fixes

- **Fixed a native resource leak decoding subset images** — SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI) no longer leaks the underlying native resource on each call. ([#3997](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3997))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

Buffer.AddUtf8(string) and Tag.Parse now avoid per-call allocations, and the bundled HarfBuzz updates to 14.2.1.
